# War Scroll Column 19 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 19 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**1** [...] they shall rise [...] the warrior hero [...] and the gates [...]

**2** [...] You have strengthened [...] Your hand [...] upon the peoples [...]

**3** [...] You have [com]manded us [...] our generations [...] Your wondrous deeds [...] and

**4** Your judgments [...] You have dealt wondrously with the poor [...] and with those who are refined [...]

**5** [...] You have acted mightily [...] in the night [...] and in the morning [...]

**6** [...] for the greatness of [...] the covenant of [...] our fathers [...]

**7** [...] the community of the holy ones [...] glorious ones [...] in the assembly of [...] knowledge [...]

**8** [...] the mighty ones of [...] righteousness [...] and the wonder of [...] Your glory [...]

**9** [...] the deeds of [...] Your hand [...] the peoples of [...]

**10** [...] righteous judgment [...] the congregation of Your truth [...] the chosen ones [...]

**11** [...] we have rejoiced [...] in Your steadfast love [...] and in Your salvation [...]

**12** [...] Your mighty arm [...] has not turned back [...] for all [...]

**13** [...] the appointed times of Your glory [...] the congregation of [...] truth [...]

**14** [...] for all the times of eternity [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 19 is the final, most damaged column of 1QM. The victory hymn continues from col. 18 with praise to God for deliverance. Only small fragments survive for most lines. "Steadfast love" for chesed in the hymnic context (19:11). "Warrior hero" renders gibbor milchamah. This column concludes the War Scroll.*
